017package org.apache.juneau.console;
018
019import java.util.*;
020import java.util.regex.*;
021
022/**
023 * A click-triggered action on an element: an icon button that calls a handler.
024 *
025 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
026 * <p class='bjava'>
027 *   ModelAction.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"archive"</js>).icon(<js>"archive"</js>).label(<js>"Archive"</js>).handler(<js>"orders.archive"</js>);
028 * </p>
029 *
030 * @since 10.0.0
031 */
032public final class ModelAction {
033
034   private static final Pattern ID = Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}$");
035
036   private final String id;
037   private String icon, label, tooltip, tone;
038   private HandlerRef handler;
039   private Map<String,Object> payload;
040
041   private ModelAction(String id) {
042      if (id == null || ! ID.matcher(id).matches())
043         throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action id '" + id + "' must match " + ID.pattern());
044      this.id = id;
045   }
046
047   /**
048    * Starts an action.
049    *
050    * @param id The action id, unique per element.
051    * @return A new action.
052    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the id is malformed.
053    */
054   public static ModelAction of(String id) {
055      return new ModelAction(id);
056   }
057
058   /**
059    * Returns the action id.
060    *
061    * @return The id.
062    */
063   public String id() {
064      return id;
065   }
066
067   /**
068    * Sets the icon (a sprite name).
069    *
070    * @param v The icon.
071    * @return This object.
072    */
073   public ModelAction icon(String v) {
074      icon = v;
075      return this;
076   }
077
078   /**
079    * Sets the visible label.
080    *
081    * @param v The label.
082    * @return This object.
083    */
084   public ModelAction label(String v) {
085      label = v;
086      return this;
087   }
088
089   /**
090    * Sets the tooltip.
091    *
092    * @param v The tooltip.
093    * @return This object.
094    */
095   public ModelAction tooltip(String v) {
096      tooltip = v;
097      return this;
098   }
099
100   /**
101    * Sets the tone.
102    *
103    * @param v The tone.
104    * @return This object.
105    */
106   public ModelAction tone(String v) {
107      tone = v;
108      return this;
109   }
110
111   /**
112    * Sets the handler by name.
113    *
114    * @param name A registered handler name or a listed built-in ({@code juneau.refresh}).
115    * @return This object.
116    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the name is malformed.
117    */
118   public ModelAction handler(String name) {
119      return handler(HandlerRef.named(name));
120   }
121
122   /**
123    * Sets the handler.
124    *
125    * @param ref The handler reference.
126    * @return This object.
127    */
128   public ModelAction handler(HandlerRef ref) {
129      handler = Objects.requireNonNull(ref, "handler");
130      return this;
131   }
132
133   /**
134    * Sets the payload merged into the event payload.
135    *
136    * @param v The payload.
137    * @return This object.
138    */
139   public ModelAction payload(Map<String,Object> v) {
140      payload = v == null ? null : new LinkedHashMap<>(v);
141      return this;
142   }
143
144   /**
145    * Returns the handler.
146    *
147    * @return The handler, or <jk>null</jk> if not yet set.
148    */
149   HandlerRef handlerRef() {
150      return handler;
151   }
152
153   /**
154    * Serializes to the contract shape.
155    *
156    * @return The map, with {@code "type":"handler"}.
157    * @throws IllegalStateException If no handler was set.
158    */
159   public Map<String,Object> toMap() {
160      if (handler == null)
161         throw new IllegalStateException("Action '" + id + "' has no handler.");
162      var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
163      m.put("type", "handler");
164      m.put("id", id);
165      if (icon != null)
166         m.put("icon", icon);
167      if (label != null)
168         m.put("label", label);
169      if (tooltip != null)
170         m.put("tooltip", tooltip);
171      if (tone != null)
172         m.put("tone", tone);
173      m.put("handler", handler.toJson());
174      if (payload != null)
175         m.put("payload", payload);
176      return m;
177   }
178}
